title: You can now turn off Google Gemini’s visible watermarks
content_snippet: Google will now allow you to remove visible watermarks from the images, videos, and music made with AI tools. With the update, you can toggle off a new "Media watermark" setting in Gemini and Google's AI video generator, Flow. When toggled off, Google will remove the "sparkle" watermark that appears in the bottom-right corner of […]
title_zh: 用户现可关闭谷歌 Gemini 的可见水印
summary_zh: 谷歌允许用户移除其 AI 工具生成的图片、视频和音乐中的可见水印，用户可在 Gemini 和 Flow 中关闭“媒体水印”设置。
key_points: 谷歌让用户可关闭 Gemini 及 Flow 的可见水印
关闭水印设置不影响隐形数字标识符

title: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermark from its AI generations
content_snippet: Turning off this setting won't affect invisible benchmarks used to identify an AI generated file
title_zh: 谷歌将允许用户移除其 AI 生成内容的可见水印
summary_zh: 谷歌宣布用户可移除其 AI 生成内容中的可见水印，但关闭此设置不会影响用于识别 AI 生成文件的隐形标识。
key_points: 用户可自主移除谷歌 AI 生成内容的可见水印
隐形水印等数字标识符不受影响，仍用于溯源
